claim: MoveMaker provides separate opportunity, continuity, public-value, and contract-cost context for incumbent-club extension decisions.
evidence_boundary: Every displayed module passed its own out-of-time evidence gate.

claim: An offer is above or below historical extension peers.
evidence_boundary: Peer deviation is descriptive and uncertain; it is not optimality or causation.

claim: The model estimates horizon-specific probabilities and broad ranges.
evidence_boundary: Do not convert them into exact dates, minutes, sale proceeds, or guarantees.

claim: The overall contract score predicts whether the deal will succeed.
evidence_boundary: The three-module composite did not establish incremental value over the best component.

claim: The model recommends the optimal wage or contract length.
evidence_boundary: Historical peer benchmarks do not observe club utility, negotiation leverage, or causal contract effects.

claim: Fee plus wages equals total acquisition cost.
evidence_boundary: Taxes, agent fees, signing fees, add-ons, options, clauses, and financing are missing.

claim: Market-value preservation equals resale profit or ROI.
evidence_boundary: Public estimates are not realized proceeds or accounting values.

claim: Extension-model probabilities apply to a player joining a new club.
evidence_boundary: Phases 1-4 were evaluated on incumbent-club extension events.

claim: A low probability means the player is tactically incompatible.
evidence_boundary: The models predict outcomes, not causal tactical compatibility.
